messages.subject: Dubai Energy & Commodities Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Tura Executive Team,

Your Dubai-based executive-search coverage across energy, oil and gas, metals, commodities and corporate leadership makes this a relevant introduction. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and wider international markets where institutional relationships, responsible development and strategic execution are central to performance. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
